rule: Compare completed request rate against90% of the realized scheduled Poisson arrival rate,not90% of nominal offered QPS. Keep the TTFT/drain branch,grid multipliers,requests,seeds and metric definitions unchanged. Preserve offered QPS as the graph coordinate and report realized arrival separately.
reason: A finite Poisson trace can realize fewer arrivals per second than nominal offered QPS. The original rate branch could incorrectly label that sampling fluctuation as server saturation.
